title: Trends in U.S. Medical Cannabis Registrations and Reasons for Use, 2016 to 2024
“Fever and no delight”
abstract: The adaptation of James Baldwin’s second novel Giovanni’s Room staged by the Quintessence Theater in Philadelphia in the summer of 2025 enjoyed an extended, sold-out run. The dramaturgical choices by co-adaptors Benjamin Sprunger and Paul Oakley Stvovall, deft stage design, and general fidelity to the text worked well. But this production’s insistence on interpreting the novel as a metaphor for gay or queer liberation misses the subterranean plot governing the novel, which is fundamentally about the miracle of love and the spiritual famine that can result when you deny your love for anyone—no matter the name. The piece considers the context of the production and the significant challenges confronting stage adaptations.

title: Water Quality and Sediment Mercury Risk Analysis in an ASGM-Impacted Rawas River
journal: Journal of Business, Social and Technology
abstract: Background: Illegal artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) can degrade river water quality while transferring mercury (Hg) from the water column to sediments, where contamination may persist beyond the sampling period. Objective: This study assessed water quality, pollution status, sediment Hg contamination, potential ecological risk, spatial differences, and associations between Hg and water-quality parameters in the Rawas River, Indonesia. Methods: A quantitative observational survey was conducted during a single sampling campaign at upstream, midstream, and downstream stations, with three spatial replicates per station, yielding nine water samples and nine sediment samples. Results: Total suspended solids ranged from 159.50 to 260.33 mg/L, while dissolved oxygen ranged from 0.43 to 0.57 mg/L. Pollution Index values of 2.62–3.36 classified all stations as lightly polluted. Mean water Hg concentrations remained below the Class II standard, although one downstream sample reached 0.00240 mg/L. Mean sediment Hg concentrations ranged from 0.12 to 0.20 mg/kg and exceeded the geochemical reference value of 0.08 mg/kg at every station. The CF indicated moderate contamination, Igeo indicated unpolluted to slightly polluted conditions, and the ecological risk was moderate upstream but considerable in the midstream and downstream areas. ANOVA and Pearson correlation analyses showed no statistically significant results (p > 0.05). Conclusion: The paired water–sediment evidence indicates that water-only compliance measurements may understate persistent sediment Hg risk, supporting integrated monitoring in ASGM-affected tropical rivers.

title: Trajectory of functional recovery and health-related quality of life following multilevel soft-tissue surgery in children with spastic diplegic cerebral palsy: a prospective longitudinal observational study
abstract: This prospective longitudinal observational study characterized 3-year functional mobility and health-related quality-of-life trajectories following single-event multilevel soft-tissue surgery in 32 children with spastic diplegic cerebral palsy, Gross Motor Function Classification System levels II–IV. Functional Mobility Scale (FMS) scores at 5, 50, and 500 m and parent-proxy Pediatric Quality of Life Inventory (PedsQL) Cerebral Palsy Module scores were assessed preoperatively and at 3, 6, 9 months, 1 year, and 3 years. FMS varied over time at all distances (Friedman P < 0.001). Median 5-m and 50-m FMS fell from 4.5 preoperatively to 2.0 at 3 months and returned to 4.5 by 3 years; baseline-to-3-year shifts were favorable (5 m: Bonferroni-adjusted P = 0.0087, r = 0.608; 50 m: adjusted P = 0.0158, r = 0.579). At 500 m, the median increased from 0 to 4.5 (adjusted P = 0.0191, r = 0.570), while N (does not apply; distance not completed) decreased from 19/32 to 8/32; 4.5 is an interpolated median between categories 4 and 5. Mean PedsQL increased from 68.2 ± 14.7 to 74.3 ± 14.5 (change +6.13, 95% confidence interval = 4.30–7.96; P < 0.001) without early decline. No FMS distance changed significantly from 1 to 3 years. Short- and intermediate-distance mobility showed early deterioration followed by recovery to baseline medians, whereas community mobility and caregiver-reported quality of life showed favorable long-term shifts. These observational changes cannot be attributed solely to surgery.

title: The decomposition dilemma: Why forensic science needs both humans and pigs
T he S hock E ffect of N egative E xperience- O riented D anmaku UGC on I nstant S ales in D ouyin F oundation L ive S treaming R ooms
journal: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
abstract: Danmaku in beauty live-streaming serves as a core real-time reference for consumers to judge the practical application effect of foundation before making purchase decisions. For such highly experience-dependent cosmetic products that cannot be physically tested in online shopping scenarios, negative user-generated comments embedded in live-stream danmaku exert far-reaching and significant impacts on real-time transactions and instant conversion within live-stream rooms. Against the backdrop of booming social commerce live-streaming, a peculiar and counter-intuitive phenomenon has been widely observed in Douyin foundation live-stream rooms: rather than merely suppressing product sales, negative experience-related comments can reversely drive sales growth under certain conditions. Drawing on the classical SOR (Stimulus-Organism-Response), ELM (Elaboration Likelihood Model) and HSM (Heuristic-Systematic Model) theories of consumer behavior, this paper systematically sorts out domestic and international relevant literature in the field of e-commerce live-streaming. It further summarizes four critical action mechanisms behind this counter-intuitive effect, including platform algorithmic logic, user trust perception, streamer on-site response and audience screening. Meanwhile, this study points out prominent deficiencies embedded in existing research, such as over-generalized product category selection, excessive reliance on static aggregate sales indicators, as well as theoretical frameworks and empirical designs that fail to match Douyin's unique content-driven traffic logic. This review clarifies existing research gaps in vertical beauty live-streaming scenarios and provides solid theoretical support for subsequent empirical research on the two-way impact of negative danmaku, as well as practical guidance for public opinion monitoring and management of beauty live-stream operations.

title: Statistical Inference on the Generalized Lifetime Performance Index of the Odd Lindley Half-Logistic Distribution
abstract: Abstract Performance capability indices are valuable measures to evaluate the quality of a product. We consider inference on the Generalized Lifetime Performance Index when the product’s lifetime follows the Odd Lindley Half-Logistic distribution. The maximum likelihood estimator of the GLPI is derived, and its asymptotic variance is established. Asymptotic confidence intervals are considered, and a uniformly most powerful test for process capability is developed. A Monte Carlo simulation study is conducted to compare the bias and mean squared error of the proposed estimator. Two real datasets on the breaking stress and strength of carbon fibers are used to illustrate the proposed methods.

title: Generative artificial intelligence-enabled dynamic capabilities and sustainable supply chain resilience: the serial mediating effect of bricolage strategy and circular supply chain innovation
journal: Journal of Global Operations and Strategic Sourcing
abstract: Purpose This study aims to address research gaps in this area by examining the relationships between generative artificial intelligence–enabled dynamic capabilities (GAI-DC), bricolage strategy (BS), circular supply chain innovation (CSCI) and sustainable supply chain resilience (SSCRes) in the small and medium enterprises retailing sector. Design/methodology/approach To test the direct and indirect relationships within the model, dynamic capabilities theory was used as a theoretical framework. A self-administered questionnaire was developed to collect cross-sectional data, yielding 249 responses from various organizational levels within these establishments. All necessary tests, such as validity and reliability, were conducted using partial least squares structural equation modeling, and the results were analyzed. Findings All hypotheses were supported, confirming that BS and CSCI serially mediate the relationship between GAI-DC and SSCRes. Research limitations/implications This study identified a wide range of practical contributions that would enhance the sustainability and resilience of supply chains. Originality/value Based on this, pioneering and innovative theoretical and practical contributions have been made in the context of sustainable supply chain management.
